Question 13
?

What is the trace in the yz-plane of the elliptic paraboloid z+1=(x−2)24+(y−1)23.

a
A parabola: z=3(y−1)2
b
A parabola: z=13(y−1)2
c
A hyperbola: x2−3(y−1)2=1
d
Two intersecting lines: y=±(x−1)
e
Two parallel lines: y=(z±3)
